note: Plate assets generated in this repository; see each entry's dimension_sources.
The generic library follows published dimensional classes. Plates listed under
a manufacturer's name are modelled from that manufacturer's published catalogue
or technique-guide drawings, or from measurement of the plate in hand, as their
sources say. None is the manufacturer's CAD: check every dimension against the
plate you hold before relying on it.

plates.name: Low-profile reconstruction plate 2.4, straight, 8 holes
plates.notice: Generic parametric approximation - not manufacturer-specific and not for clinical device selection.
plates.coordinate_convention: +z out of the outer face at the middle hole, the plate running along +x there; origin at the middle hole's centre
dimension_sources: Conventional low-profile 2.4 mm reconstruction plate modelled at 135 x 8 x 2.4 mm (finite element study of low-profile reconstruction plates for the atrophic mandible).
Generic round-hole reconstruction plates listed at 62 mm for 8 holes up to 188 mm for 24 holes, i.e. about 8 mm per hole.
Reconstruction plates carry notches between screw holes so that they bend between holes rather than through them (AO technique teaching).
